title: DSS: Dynamic Semantic Steering for Robust Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.16483v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have introduced new security risks, as adversaries can exploit flexible text prompts to induce the generation of sensitive or policy-violating content (e.g., NSFW or copyrighted concepts). Concept erasure has emerged as a promising defense, aiming to suppress targeted semantics while preserving benign generation. However, existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: training-based methods are costly and inflexible to emerging threats, while inference-time interventions often rely on unconstrained feature manipulation, leading to over-correction, semantic drift, and degraded utility. More critically, they lack an explicit understanding of local semantic structure, resulting in unstable behavior under adversarial or compositional prompts. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Semantic Steering (DSS), a training-free, inference-time defense framework for robust and controllable concept erasure

translated_title: DSS：用于扩散模型中鲁棒概念擦除的动态语义引导
translated_abstract: 文生图（T2I）扩散模型带来了新的安全风险，因为攻击者可以利用灵活的文本提示诱导模型生成敏感或违反政策的内容（例如NSFW或受版权保护的概念）。概念擦除已成为一种有前景的防御手段，旨在抑制目标语义的同时保留良性生成能力。然而，现有方法面临一个根本性的权衡：基于训练的方法成本高昂，且难以灵活应对新兴威胁；而推理时干预通常依赖于不受约束的特征操纵，导致过度校正、语义漂移和实用性下降。更关键的是，这些方法缺乏对局部语义结构的显式理解，导致在对抗性或组合性提示下行为不稳定。本文提出了动态语义引导（DSS），这是一个无需训练的推理时防御框架，能够实现鲁棒且可控的概念擦除。
tldr: 提出了DSS——一种无需训练的推理时防御框架，通过动态语义引导实现扩散模型中鲁棒且可控的概念擦除，克服了现有方法过度校正、语义漂移及对抗性提示下不稳定的问题。
en_tdlr: DSS is proposed as a training-free, inference-time defense framework that achieves robust and controllable concept erasure in diffusion models through dynamic semantic steering, overcoming over-correction, semantic drift, and instability under adversarial prompts.
